name: RSS-BSLMM
model_likelihood: beta_hat approximately N(S_hat R_hat S_hat^-1 beta, S_hat R_hat S_hat); S_hat_jj^2=sigma_hat_j^2+beta_hat_j^2/n
prior: Two-normal sparse-plus-polygenic mixture with S-based variances; independent log-uniform pi and uniform h,rho hyperpriors.
inference_algorithm: MCMC sampling of posterior beta; RSS-BSLMM updates beta directly.
estimand: Posterior regression coefficients beta; PVE summarized using posterior SPVE draws.
data_input: Univariate regression effect estimates and standard errors; sample size; LD estimate from reference genotypes.
tunable_settings: Prior family (BSLMM or sparse BVSR); MCMC run length.
